text:
priya_sales: FYI enterprise POC (EU bank) hit a hard blocker. They pinned model `redwood-enterprise-1.4` and get `model_not_available_in_region` from eu-west. Also raised security questionnaire items (KMS, audit logs). Need eng + SRE swarm please.

josh_seals: Oh no. Demo scheduled tomorrow. Any error payloads?

priya_sales: Client pasted this: 
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
{
  "error": "model_not_available_in_region",
  "model": "redwood-enterprise-1.4",
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "request_id": "req_01GZ..."
}
They also tried a pinned alias and saw 429 after a couple of retries.

maya_oncall: 404 + 429 = likely model absent in eu pool + org hit rate cap on fallback. Can you share org id so I can check rate-limit headers?

raj_sre: Checking logs now. Sample response headers from our edge: 
X-Rate-Limit-Remaining: 0
X-Rate-Limit-Reset: 38
status: 429
Also confirmed the exact build tag isn't deployed to eu-west pool.

evon_eng: We can create a control-plane alias mapping `redwood-enterprise-1.4` -> `redwood-enterprise-1.4-eu-compatible` (serving variant in EU). Requires security/product sign-off for pin semantics. ETA ~2 hours if approved.

josh_seals: If alias is slow, give customer a short fallback recipe for the demo.

maya_oncall: Quick demo workarounds: 1) set header `X-Region: global` to route to global pool (higher latency), or 2) add `fallback_model` param in request: {"model":"redwood-enterprise-1.4","fallback_model":"redwood-enterprise-1.3-eu","prompt":"..."} — no control-plane change needed but customer must change client.

priya_sales: They must keep the exact pinned model for compliance ideally. Is spinning a small Dedicated trial in EU an option? Cost and lead time?

evon_eng: Dedicated trial in EU: 48-72 hours to provision a small reserved pool + onboarding. Cost uplift ~3x hosted per-token depending on GPU. Josh, can you give procurement ballpark?

raj_sre: On the security questionnaire: hosted currently offers envelope encryption with our KMS and optional audit-log retention add-on. Customer-managed KMS is available for Private deployments only. I'll prepare a one-pager for the questionnaire items (KMS, logs, encryption at rest, access controls).

priya_sales: Proposed action plan: (A) Evan drafts alias and security justification for sign-off, (B) Maya/Raj request a temporary quota bump for org to prevent 429s during demo, (C) Josh sends fallback snippet to customer for demo. Everyone OK?

maya_oncall: Opening quota escalation now. Can push a short bump for 4 hours if infra approves.

evon_eng: I'll draft alias PR and include audit trail for mapping changes. Will wait on security ack before applying.

deploy-bot: deployment request queued: quota-bump/eu-west/org-4321  awaiting approvers (2026-03-21T10:12:00Z).

josh_seals: Customer agreed to try the `fallback_model` approach for the demo. We'll monitor. I'll chase finance for Dedicated quote in parallel.

priya_sales: Thanks all. Please report back here once alias is live or quota bump is approved. Demo at 14:00 CET tomorrow.

maya_oncall: Will update when infra approves.

evon_eng: Draft ready; will push after security confirmation.

priya_sales: End thread for now, will reopen if demo hits issues.
